newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Oct 16.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Oct 16.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
* News Corp Ltd A$7.20 (-.14)

The company's chairman and chief executive Rupert Murdoch told shareholders at the company's annual meeting in Adelaide that first quarter earnings for the group were below expectations but the company still expected a 20 per cent rise in annual profit.
* Woolworths Ltd A$2.82 (+.02)

Australia's second largest retailer has forged a deal, worth A$750 million a year within five years, with Castrol's petroleum subsidiary Burmah Fuels and Japanese trading house Mitsui, the Australian Financial Review newspaper reported.
* St George Bank Ltd A$8.67 (+.12)
St George bank shares recovered slightly on Tuesday after being sold heavily on Monday following news of the bank's proposed A$2.65 billion merger with Advance Bank Ltd.

Dutch telecommunications and postal group KPN yesterday lifted its stake in takeover target TNT to 14.9 percent from 9.9 percent, just below the foreign ownership threshold of 15 percent. KPN is now awaiting approval from the Foreign Investment Review Board before it can proceed with its offer.
* Coca-Cola Amatil Ltd A$17.60 (-.33)

Food and beverage group fell after analysts at broker First Pacific Stockbroking put a sell recommendation on the stock and concluded fair value for the stock was A$12.50 a share, the Australian Financial Review newspaper reported.
* Queensland Cotton Ltd A$4.00 (+.35)
The shares of Australia's largest ginner and marketer of cotton rose sharply on Tuesday after it reported strong half earnings and a positive second half outlook on Monday.
* Sydney Aquarium Ltd A$3.40 (unch)

Tourism operator Sydney Aquarium Ltd expects to attract at least another 200,000 to 300,000 Sydneysiders to its upgraded Darling Harbour site following an A$11 million extension of the marine centre, the Australian Financial Review newspaper reported.
* Petroz NL A$0.81 (+0.04)
* Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$17.00 (+.16)
* Santos Ltd A$5.40 (+0.5)
The oil explorer said before the start of Wednesday market trade that it would develop the Elang and Kakatua fields in the Timor Sea along with its partners BHP and Santos.
-- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 373-1800
